headline: Proposed $156,000 sale of Business Park Dr. lot for a manufacturing plant, and Edgewood Pre-K Academy renovation contract raised to $29,873,359.
summary: Changes to the homestead property tax exemption would be introduced, with a public hearing set for December 1. Other business includes an update on the Chippanee Golf Course, a $6,000 offer for Witches Rock Road land, and an LED lighting upgrade at the Bristol Police Complex.

City of Bristol 
City Council 
 
Join Zoom Meeting: 
 
https://bristolct-
gov.zoom.us/j/83756772336?pwd=LzOF7rbkwiT3ytO6avQMoKmeOssFDK.1 
 
Meeting ID: 837 5677 2336 Passcode: 123456 
Dial by your Location: +19292056099 (New York) 
 
 
 
 
 
The regular City Council Meeting will be held on Tuesday, November 10, 2026, at 7:00 PM. in 
Council Chambers 111 N Main Street, Bristol, CT 06010. 
 
  
1. Call to Order 
2. Approval of Minutes 
 a. Approval of minutes of the Red Light Traffic Camera Forum held on October 6, 2026. 
 b. Approval of minutes of the regular City Council meeting held on October 13, 2026. 
 c. Approval of minutes of the special City Council meeting held on October 29, 2026. 
3. Public Participation 
4. Announcements 
5. Consent Agenda 
 a. To place on file the New Hire Report for October 2026. 
 b. To approve the Tax Refunds dated October 30, 2026. 
 c. To approve the 2027 City Council meeting calendar 
 d. To authorize the Mayor or Acting Mayor to execute a short-term contract extension 
with Valsoft Corporation Inc., dba Cott Systems, for the Town Clerk's Office 
document recording system; and to refer this matter to the office of Corporation 
Counsel.
e. To authorize the Mayor or Acting Mayor to execute a contract by and between Info 
Quick Solutions, Inc. (IQS) and the City of Bristol for installation of a new document 
recording system in May 2027; and to refer this matter to the Office of Corporation 
Counsel for review. 
 f. To place on file a positive referral for a C.G.S. Section 8-24 review for the sale of the 
property located at 190 Business Park Dr., Map 3, Lot 6. 
 g. To place on file the following motion from the Bristol Zoning Commission:  Motion to 
prepare a Zoning Text Amendment application to remove the Data Center Special 
Permit use (15,001 sq. ft. - 250,000 sq. ft.) from the principal use summary table 
listed in Article II, Section 4.2 of the Zoning Regulations.  The Text Amendment 
application will be received at the January 2027, Regular meeting and then 
scheduled for a Public Hearing by the Commission, once the application is 
received.  With respect to the Data Center Site Plan uses (15,000 sq. ft. or less) 
currently allowed in the BHC zone, the referral from Council suggested additional 
restrictions such as adding a Special Permit requirement and adding separation 
distances between Data Centers.  The Zoning Commission is not considering any 
further changes to the Regulations at this time. 
 h. To recommend that Mayor Ellen Zoppo-Sassu, or Acting Mayor, execute a Purchase 
and Sale Agreement and to complete the property transaction, subject to the 
approval of Corporation Counsel, with Integrity Mfg. LLC. or its assigns for the sale 
and redevelopment of Lot #6, identified as parcel 3-6 on the City land records, for the 
purchase price of $156,000 to construct an approximately 23,100 square foot 
manufacturing facility to be occupied by Integrity Manufacturing.  
 i. To authorize the Mayor or Acting Mayor to execute a contract amendment to Contract 
2C25-068 Brace Ave & O’Sullivan Drive Storm Drainage, in the amount of $30,250 
with Martin Laviero Contractors Inc., increasing the total contract amount from 
$2,075,583 to $2,105,833. 
6. Reports and Committee Reports 
 a. Real Estate Committee - To accept the offer from Brett Michael Benincasa, in 
response to Request for Proposal 2027-013, for the purchase of city-owned property 
known as Lot 6+7+8 Witches Rock Road on Tax Assessor’s Map 8 for the sales price 
of $6,000.00; to authorize the Mayor or Acting Mayor to sign any documents 
necessary to effectuate this motion, and that this matter be referred to the 
Corporation Counsel. This city lot to be conveyed shall merge with the owner’s 
property known as 580 Witches Rock Road and can never be subdivided in the 
future. This restriction shall run with the land.  
 b. Ordinance Committee - To introduce the following amendments to Chapter 12, 
Housing, Article XIII, Section 12-196 - 12-209 Homestead Property Tax Exemption of 
the Bristol Code of Ordinances; to set Tuesday, December 1, 2026 at 4:45 p.m., in 
Meeting Room 1-1, City Hall, First Floor, 111 North Main Street, Bristol, Connecticut 
for the holding of a Public Hearing by the Ordinance Committee; that the City Clerk
publish notice of said Public Hearing and the proposed amendments to the Code of 
Ordinances as required by City Charter; and to waive the reading of the proposed 
amendments to the Code of Ordinances to be introduced this date. 
7. Old Business 
8. New Business 
 a. Update on the acquisition of Chippanee Golf Course 
9. Resignations 
10. Appointments 
 a. Board and Commission Appointments. 
11. Contracts 
 a. To amend Contract 2P26-060 Construction Management at Risk for the Renovation 
of Edgewood Pre-K Academy with D'Amato+Downes Joint Venture in the amount of 
$28,217,964.12 bringing their GMP to $29,873,359 and to authorize the Mayor or 
Acting Mayor to execute any documents necessary.  
 b. To authorize the Chief of Police or his designee to sign any and all documents related 
to the Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) between the CJIS-CT Governing Board 
and the Bristol Police Department, covering the department’s participation in the 
Connecticut Information Sharing System. (CJIS). 
 c. To authorize the Mayor or Acting Mayor to execute Amendment No. 4 to Contract 
2C26-002 Renovations at the Beals Community Center – Bristol-Burlington Health 
District Space, with Orlando Annulli & Sons, Inc., in the amount of $92,000, 
increasing the total contract amount from $2,339,829 to $2,431,829. The amendment 
will provide for the integration of the renovated BBHD HVAC equipment into the City's 
existing Schneider Electric StruxureWare Building Management System and 
conversion of the remaining Beals Community Center HVAC controls to the same 
platform, allowing DPW to remotely monitor and control HVAC operations throughout 
the entire facility. 
 d. To authorize the Mayor or Acting Mayor to execute any and all documents necessary 
to proceed with the LED Lighting Upgrade Project at the Bristol Police Complex, 
located at 131 North Main Street, to be performed by Resource Lighting & Energy, 
Inc. (RLE), in accordance with the Eversource Energy Efficiency Program. 
12. Executive Session 
 a. To discuss Robert Wentland v. City of Bristol, WCC #: 7076821; and take action if 
necessary.
13. Any other matter to come before said meeting 
14. Adjournment 
  
Erica Cabiya 
Town & City Clerk
